summary: BioMar Group A/S provides feeding solutions in the aquaculture industry in Denmark. It operates through four segments: Salmon, Shrimp, Selected Species, and Tech Solutions. The company develops, produces, and delivers feeding solutions for species, such as salmon, shrimp, sea bass, sea bream, trout, turbot, and sturgeon to farmers. It also offers aquaculture feed solutions for Atlantic and Pacific salmon, warm-water shrimp, and other special species. In addition, the company provides AI-based technology solutions for aquacultural feeding and farming. BioMar Group A/S was formerly known as Dansk Ørredfoder A/S and changed its name to BioMar Group A/S in 1994. The company was incorporated in 1962 and is based in Aarhus, Denmark. BioMar Group A/S operates as a subsidiary of Aktieselskabet Schouw & Co.
